gui.spellcraft.help_12: Red outline on a module means the error happened there

gui.spellcraft.help_3: LMB a line — disconnect · RMB an input — disconnect

gui.spellcraft.help_6: Shift+LMB or Delete — delete · LMB a block — select
gui.spellcraft.help_8: Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V — copy the spell to clipboard and paste
gui.spellcraft.help_9: H — help · B — spell library · ESC — close

gui.spellcraft.help_mod_3: Every checkbox adds mana per cast (+10, +12, +8, ...)
gui.spellcraft.help_mod_5: No block damage/Wider radius, Set on fire/Shove
gui.spellcraft.help_mod_6: The number input is radius, fortune level or power

gui.spellcraft.locked_desc: This module is not learned yet.
gui.spellcraft.locked_requires_desc: First learn "%s" and this one will unlock too.
gui.spellcraft.locked_scan_desc: Not learned yet. Scan a suitable block or entity with the Analyze module to unlock it forever.
gui.spellcraft.locked_toast: Module "%s" is not learned yet — scan something
gui.spellcraft.nav_hint: Infinite grid: LMB/MMB — move, wheel — zoom
gui.spellcraft.optional_hint: optional inputs can be left unconnected
gui.spellcraft.palette_hint: Hover or hold a module to see its description. You can drag it onto the grid.
gui.spellcraft.panel_mana: Mana only comes from the Extract module. Cap: %s.
gui.spellcraft.panel_progress_desc: Analysis points: %s. Modules unlocked: %s of %s. Scan blocks and entities to unlock more.
hint.spellcraft.break_area_fortune: Number = radius (1-6), fortune is always level 3
hint.spellcraft.break_plain: No number needed — checkboxes do not change mining
library.spellcraft.title: Spell library
message.spellcraft.library_full: All %s library slots are occupied — delete a spell first
modifier.spellcraft.area.desc: Breaks an area around the point. The number input is the radius. Conflicts with Instant mining.
modifier.spellcraft.fire.desc: Sets everything in radius on fire. Conflicts with Shove.
modifier.spellcraft.fortune.desc: Loot is rolled with fortune. The number input is the fortune level (1-5).
modifier.spellcraft.hint: You can combine checkboxes, except conflicting pairs
modifier.spellcraft.instant.desc: Breaks the whole vein at once (up to 32 blocks, 2 mana each). Conflicts with By area.
modifier.spellcraft.no_blocks.desc: The explosion does not break blocks but still damages. Conflicts with Wider radius.
modifier.spellcraft.powerful.desc: Noticeably more power and radius. Combines with any other variant.
modifier.spellcraft.shove.desc: Shoves entities away from the epicentre. Conflicts with Set on fire.
modifier.spellcraft.silk.desc: The block itself drops, like Silk Touch. Conflicts with Fortune.
modifier.spellcraft.wait: Wait, the previous attempt is not resolved yet
modifier.spellcraft.wide.desc: Explosion radius is 1.5x bigger. Conflicts with No block damage.
module.spellcraft.block_at.desc: Reads the block at a point as an item, without breaking it. Lets a spell take a block out of the world and place or drop it elsewhere. Input: point. Output: item.
module.spellcraft.clear_block.desc: Removes a block without dropping it. Use when a block should not turn into loot. Input: point. Output: the same point.
module.spellcraft.consume_item.desc: Takes an item out of the caster's inventory and outputs what was taken, so it can go on. The mirror of Give item: together they move items without creating any. Input: item. Output: item.
module.spellcraft.drop_item.desc: Throws an item at a point. Inputs: item, point. Output: the point.
module.spellcraft.empty_hand.desc: 1 when the selected hand is empty, 0 otherwise. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.fill_region.desc: Fills the box between two points with an item. Blocks come from the caster's inventory, so the region is never an infinite source: it fills as far as the blocks last. Inputs: corner, opposite corner, item. Output: the second point.
module.spellcraft.fluid_at.desc: Reads the fluid at a point as a bucket. Input: point. Output: item (a bucket).
module.spellcraft.give_item.desc: Puts an item into the caster's inventory and outputs how many fit. Nothing is created: the stack is moved, not copied. Input: item. Output: number given.
module.spellcraft.held_slot.desc: Reads an item from a hotbar slot. 1 is the hand itself, 9 is the far slot. Input: slot number. Output: item.
module.spellcraft.offhand_item.desc: The item in the offhand. Output: item.
module.spellcraft.stack_clear_slots.desc: Frees every cell at once. Output: nothing.
module.spellcraft.stack_drop_n.desc: Removes N values from the top of the stack. Without a number it removes one. Input: optional count. Output: nothing.
module.spellcraft.stack_exit.desc: Stops the cast early. With a condition, it stops when the value is not zero; without one it always stops. Not an error: the rest of the graph is simply skipped. Input: optional condition. Output: nothing.
module.spellcraft.stack_load.desc: Takes a value out of a cell and frees it. An empty cell is an error. Input: cell number. Output: the value.
module.spellcraft.stack_pick.desc: Copies the N-th stack value from the top without removing it. Input: depth (1 is the top). Output: the copied value.
module.spellcraft.stack_repeat.desc: Puts N copies of the top stack value on the stack. This is how a loop is built: Repeat unfolds the value, and Swap with Drop pick the copies apart. Input: repeat count. Output: the value.
module.spellcraft.stack_skip.desc: Stops the cast when the value is zero, otherwise keeps going. Useful at the start of a loop to drop an unwanted value. Input: condition. Output: nothing.
module.spellcraft.stack_slots_used.desc: How many cells hold a value. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.stack_store.desc: Puts a value into a cell, so it outlives the stack. A busy cell is not overwritten. Inputs: value, cell number. Output: the value.
module.spellcraft.stack_swap.desc: Swaps the top value with the N-th from the top, keeping everything in between. Depth 1 changes nothing. Input: depth (1 is the top). Output: the value that was on top.
module.spellcraft.abs.desc: Absolute value: makes a negative number positive.
module.spellcraft.add.desc: Adds two numbers. Inputs: two numbers. Output: the sum.
module.spellcraft.analysis_block.desc: Scans a block. If the block teaches a module you do not know yet, it unlocks permanently. Output: 1 for a new module, 0 if already known. Free.
module.spellcraft.analysis_mob.desc: Scans an entity. If it teaches a module you do not know yet, it unlocks permanently. Output: 1 for a new module, 0 if already known. Free.
module.spellcraft.and.desc: Logical and: 1 if both numbers are non-zero.
module.spellcraft.arrow.desc: Shoots a flaming arrow along a direction vector.
Block point the caster looks at. Shortcut for Look → Ray: block.
module.spellcraft.break_block.desc: Breaks a block. Inputs: point and an optional number (area radius or fortune level). Variants are checkboxes: right-click the module.
module.spellcraft.caster_entity.desc: Pushes the entity casting the spell. Output: entity. Start of most spells.
module.spellcraft.clamp.desc: Clamps a number: value, min and max.
module.spellcraft.compare.desc: Compares two numbers: 1 if bigger, -1 if smaller, 0 if equal.
module.spellcraft.coord_x.desc: Takes the X coordinate of a point. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.coord_y.desc: Takes the Y coordinate of a point. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.coord_z.desc: Takes the Z coordinate of a point. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.cos.desc: Cosine of an angle in degrees. Input: degrees. Output: number from -1 to 1.
module.spellcraft.create_fire.desc: Spawns fire at a point. Input: point.
module.spellcraft.create_lava.desc: Places a lava source at a point. Input: point.
module.spellcraft.create_water.desc: Places a water source at a point. Input: point.
module.spellcraft.damage.desc: Damages an entity. Inputs: entity and number. Output: the same entity, so you can chain it (e.g. into Impulse or Sparkle).
module.spellcraft.divide.desc: Divides the first number by the second. Division by zero is an error.
module.spellcraft.drain_liquids.desc: Removes liquids (water and lava) in an area. Inputs: point and optional area.
module.spellcraft.duplicate.desc: Sends the input to both outputs, so you can wire it to two modules.
module.spellcraft.effect_desc: Applies the "%s" effect. Inputs: entity, seconds, level (0-4). Output: the same entity.
module.spellcraft.effect_desc_plain: Applies a status effect. Inputs: entity, seconds, level (0-4). Output: the same entity.
module.spellcraft.entities_nearby.desc: How many living entities are within 16 blocks.
module.spellcraft.entity_look.desc: Look direction of an entity. Input: entity. Output: vector — feed it into a Ray module.
module.spellcraft.entity_position.desc: Entity position as a world point. Input: entity. Output: point.
module.spellcraft.entity_under_crosshair: Living entity the caster looks at (up to 32 blocks).
module.spellcraft.explode.desc: Explosion at a point. Inputs: point and power (0-8). Variants are checkboxes: right-click the module.
module.spellcraft.extract_block.desc: Draws mana out of a block. Every block has its own price (ore is worth more than stone). Costs no mana. Output: mana gained.
module.spellcraft.extract_mob.desc: Draws mana out of an entity: the tougher it is, the more it gives. Costs no mana. Output: mana gained.
module.spellcraft.fireball.desc: Shoots a fireball along a direction vector. No outputs.
module.spellcraft.heal.desc: Heals an entity. Inputs: entity and number. Output: the same entity, chainable.
module.spellcraft.heal_percent.desc: Heals a percent of max health. Output: the same entity.
module.spellcraft.held_item.desc: Item in the caster's main hand.
module.spellcraft.ignite.desc: Sets an entity on fire for N seconds. Output: the same entity.
module.spellcraft.impulse.desc: Pushes an entity along a vector. Inputs: entity and vector. Output: the same entity.
module.spellcraft.is_air.desc: 1 if there is air at the point, otherwise 0.
module.spellcraft.is_player.desc: 1 if the entity is a player, otherwise 0. Great with Select.
module.spellcraft.item_count.desc: How many of that item the caster carries.
module.spellcraft.lerp.desc: Smooth transition between two numbers: 0 gives the first, 1 the second, 0.5 the middle. Inputs: first, second, position. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.lightning.desc: Spawns lightning at a point. No outputs.
module.spellcraft.line_blocks.desc: How many block positions the segment between two points passes through. A ray 10 blocks long reports 11. Inputs: two points. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.modulo.desc: Remainder. Division by zero is an error.
module.spellcraft.multiply.desc: Multiplies two numbers. Output: the product.
module.spellcraft.negate.desc: Flips the sign of a number.
module.spellcraft.or.desc: Logical or: 1 if at least one number is non-zero.
module.spellcraft.pick_first.desc: Returns the first input value, skipping the second.
module.spellcraft.pick_second.desc: Returns the second input value, skipping the first.
module.spellcraft.place_block.desc: Places a block from an item at a point (single block) or over the whole area. Inputs: point, item and optional area.
module.spellcraft.place_held_block.desc: Places the block the caster holds. Inputs: point and optional area. Consumes durability.
module.spellcraft.point_direction.desc: Direction from the first point to the second. Inputs: two points. Output: vector.
module.spellcraft.point_distance.desc: Exact distance between two points. Inputs: two points. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.point_from_coords.desc: Builds a point from three numbers: X, Y, Z. Output: point.
module.spellcraft.point_midpoint.desc: Middle of the segment between two points. Inputs: two points. Output: point.
module.spellcraft.point_offset.desc: Moves a point by a vector. With a number connected, the vector is scaled by it first; without one the vector is used as is. Inputs: point, vector, optional number. Output: point.
module.spellcraft.power.desc: Raises the first number to the second.
module.spellcraft.random_range.desc: Random number between two numbers (any order).
module.spellcraft.raycast_block.desc: Finds the block along the look direction. Feed it into another module to pick the target at cast time.
module.spellcraft.raycast_entity.desc: Finds the first living entity along a direction. Input: vector. Output: entity — plug into Damage or Heal.
module.spellcraft.select.desc: If the first number is bigger than the second, takes input 3, otherwise input 4. Conditionals!
module.spellcraft.select_random.desc: Randomly picks one of two values.
module.spellcraft.set_health.desc: Sets entity health (0 means dead). Output: the same entity.
module.spellcraft.sign.desc: Returns -1, 0 or 1 depending on the sign.
module.spellcraft.sin.desc: Sine of an angle in degrees. Input: degrees. Output: number from -1 to 1.
module.spellcraft.sound.desc: Plays a sound, pitch taken from a number. No outputs.
module.spellcraft.sound_at.desc: Plays a sound at a point; the number is pitch (0.5-2).
module.spellcraft.sparkle.desc: Particles at a point — handy to debug a spell. No outputs.
module.spellcraft.sqrt.desc: Square root. Negative input is an error.
module.spellcraft.stack_pop.desc: Takes the top value from the stack. Empty stack is an error.
module.spellcraft.stack_push.desc: Pushes the input value onto the spell stack.
module.spellcraft.stack_size.desc: How many values the stack holds right now.
module.spellcraft.subtract.desc: Subtracts the second number from the first. Output: the difference.
module.spellcraft.swap.desc: Swaps two values. Two outputs: top first, then bottom.
module.spellcraft.swap_blocks.desc: Swaps two blocks together with their drops. Neither block is lost: both go to the other's place and drop what they would have yielded. Inputs: two points. Output: the second point.
module.spellcraft.teleport.desc: Teleports an entity to a point. Output: the same entity.
module.spellcraft.upgrade_desc: Costs %s mana and has a %s%% chance to unlock "%s". The mana is spent either way. Output: 1 on success, 0 otherwise.
module.spellcraft.vector_add.desc: Adds two vectors component-wise. Inputs: two vectors. Output: vector.
module.spellcraft.vector_angle.desc: Angle between two vectors in degrees, from 0 to 180. Inputs: two vectors. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.vector_cone.desc: Turns a vector by a random angle within plus or minus N degrees. Inputs: vector, spread in degrees. Output: vector.
module.spellcraft.vector_cross.desc: Cross product: a vector perpendicular to both inputs. Inputs: two vectors. Output: vector.
module.spellcraft.vector_dot.desc: Scalar product of two vectors: length x length x cos(angle). Inputs: two vectors. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.vector_flat.desc: Keeps only the horizontal part of a vector, zeroing its height. Inputs: vector. Output: vector.
module.spellcraft.vector_from_coords.des: Builds a vector from three numbers (x, y, z). Inputs: three numbers. Output: vector.
module.spellcraft.vector_length.desc: Length of a vector. Input: vector. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.vector_normalize.desc: Scales a vector to length 1, keeping its direction. A zero vector stays zero.
module.spellcraft.vector_rotate_pitch.de: Tilts a vector up or down by N degrees. Positive tilts down. Inputs: vector, degrees. Output: vector.
module.spellcraft.vector_rotate_yaw.desc: Turns a vector around the vertical axis by N degrees. Follows the game rule: yaw 0 looks at +Z, positive turns left. Inputs: vector, degrees. Output: vector.
module.spellcraft.vector_scale.desc: Multiplies a vector by a number. Inputs: vector, number. Output: vector.
module.spellcraft.vector_subtract.desc: Subtracts the second vector from the first, component-wise. Inputs: two vectors. Output: vector.
panel.spellcraft.mana: Mana only comes from the Extract module. Cap: %s.
panel.spellcraft.preview_hint: Preview only evaluates numbers: constants and math
panel.spellcraft.progress_desc: Modules learned: %s of %s. Scan blocks and entities to learn new modules.
panel.spellcraft.progress_hint: Upgrades spend mana and have a chance to grant a stronger module.
panel.spellcraft.stack_empty: Stack is empty — nothing was cast
module.spellcraft.wrap_angle.desc: Wraps an angle in degrees into the range -180 to 180, so 370 becomes 10. Input: number. Output: number.
message.spellcraft.infinite_mana_off: Infinite mana OFF. Spells cost mana again. Current mana: %s
message.spellcraft.infinite_mana_on: Infinite mana ON for you: spells cost nothing until you run /spellcraft infmana again. Current mana: %s
